title: Hyundai Motor America: Air Bags & Seat Belt Pretensioners May Not Deploy in a Crash (37,901 affected)
summary: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2019-2022 Veloster N, 2019-2023 Kona Electric vehicles. A software error in the air bag control unit (ACU) may improperly deactivate the air bag system and seat belt pretensioners.
